reason: Per-profile account folders for the Claude harness, like Codex/Grok. A claude_agent_sdk profile with home_directory runs the Claude CLI with CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR=<folder> for turns (ClaudeAgentOptions env), Check (probe and the `claude auth status --json` subprocess), Test turn (harness_diagnostics opens through the same adapter) and user skills/settings (setting_sources=user reads CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR); the env is built per call, never via os.environ. A missing folder raises the shared 'Account folder is unavailable on the Nebula host' error on Check and turns. Signed-out messages name the profile folder and `CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR=<folder> claude login` (harnesses, harness_diagnostics). The domain validator accepts home_directory for managed Claude profiles (domain). Without home_directory the env construction is byte-identical. The harness settings form shows the Account folder for Claude with its login command (HarnessSettings UI). Docs: butler-supervisor-powers Claude section, harness-account-homes and the settings-assistant Claude row; product knowledge rebuilt. Python selects the new suite, the existing Claude harness/adapter/turn suites for harnesses, test_harness_test_turn_reason for harness_diagnostics, test_domain plus the two account-home domain tests in test_harnesses for domain, and the product-knowledge digest and Claude/Butler doc rows; Frontend selects the harness settings tests.
